overall_reason: Most of the old suite still states the required contracts and is kept unchanged, including the core safety controls. Three properties have to change. AutoLeaveAdvance encoded the old duplicate-append behavior, and its quota-deferral escape is no longer allowed. ProposalContract and ExpectedDecision lack the new joint-state refusal rule and the zero-payload quota exemption. Three properties are missing and need to be added: (1) committed conf entries must match the joint state they are applied in; (2) a transferee must stay a voter (abort when it is demoted); (3) newly added members are probed right away (recommended; this one is about behavior, not safety). AutoLeaveAdvance must NOT be weakened to the new source's crossing condition. The new source appears to break the auto-leave obligation in at least one in-contract scenario: a leader elected with applied==lastIndex in an autoLeave joint config never leaves it.

semantic_requirement_changes: Auto-leave: exactly one leave entry per auto-leave joint config; it can never be refused; pendingConf must cover it (AutoLeaveAdvance modified)
Conf-change admission: joint-state mismatch refusal (ProposalConfigurationDecisions modified)
Quota admission: zero-payload batches are never refused (ProposalConfigurationDecisions, OutcomeSoundness modified)
Committed conf entries are joint-coherent with the config they are applied in (CommittedConfEntryCoherence added)
Leadership transfer is aborted when the transferee stops being a voter (LeaderTransfereeIsVoter added)
New members are probed when the config switches (NewMemberProbe added; behavioral, not safety)
representation_or_observer_migrations: Model constants and progress initialisation (AutoLeaveWeight=0, AutoLeaveEncoded=EmptyEncoded, Next=Last for Changer-created progress, Restore self match=s.index-1, next=s.index; Bootstrap progress next=Len(BootLog)). These are needed for Trace correspondence and change no property
pre_existing_property_defect_repairs: AutoLeaveAdvance required an append on every eligible Advance, which mandated duplicate leave entries; its DropQuota disjunct could be met by a stale raft.decision value that AdvanceCore never resets
ProposalContract's rewritten set counted any earlier conf entry in the batch instead of an earlier ADMITTED one (the two only coincided before the joint refusal existed)
OutcomeSoundness takes o.weight from the model's own RewriteConf, so it is partly circular (noted; recommended repair)

entries.rationale: This states the requirement itself, not the source's mechanism. (1) If an Advance leaves a leader in an autoLeave joint config with no unapplied conf entry (cursor >= pendingConf), a leave entry must be pending after the last applied config entry. (2) Advance may append only a single raft-generated leave entry, and only when none is already pending; pendingConf must then cover it. (3) Refusal is not allowed: the old DropQuota escape is removed. Do NOT replace 'due' with the source's crossing predicate (oldApplied < pendingBefore). That change would hide defects D1/D2.

entries.rationale: This is the safety obligation behind the new refusal rule and the single-auto-leave fix. No committed conf entry may hit a joint-state mismatch when applied, because the source would panic. It is phrased in application semantics (IsLeave requires Transition=Auto), so it is independent of the source's admission predicate. It deliberately does not require full ValidConfigTransition, because app-induced errors such as removing all voters predate this update and are out of scope.

Admission still allows a manual leave, but no component proposes it.

The empty entry i+1 commits and Advance(cursor=i+1) appends nothing. AutoLeaveAdvance (old and modified) is violated at that Advance.

unresolved_obligations: U1: Caller contract. README:122 allows Advance before ApplyConfChange. Under that reading D2/D3/D5 are source defects; under a stricter 'apply conf changes before Advance' reading they are caller errors. The properties are stated for both. Run with EarlyAdvance=FALSE (isolates D1/D4) and EarlyAdvance=TRUE (exposes D2/D3/D5), and get a maintainer decision.
